tagline: Intelligence in service of people, not people in service of intelligence
s1_p: An honest engineering experiment: an assistant that runs on your own computer, with no cloud account and no obligation to use a model. It does not claim to be general intelligence, and when it does not know something it should say so.
p1_t: The system may propose something, but proposing does not give it authority.
p2_t: What was retrieved from a source is never treated as the same thing as what the model guessed.
p3_t: When the source matters, an honest incomplete answer comes before a polished answer with nothing behind it.
s2_p: Run these commands in a terminal. You need Python 3.10 or newer.
s2_note_mirror: If installing packages hangs (some networks block only files.pythonhosted.org), use a mirror:
s2_note_data: The fetch_data command downloads the poetry database from a Release and verifies it with SHA-256. Without it Simorgh still works, but verse attribution stays disabled.
s3_p: The service listens on 127.0.0.1 only. After it starts, open the chat interface in your browser.
s4_p: Send a question and see where the answer came from.
try_wait: Answering; on computers without a graphics processor this can take up to a minute…
try_ai: This answer was generated by a language model
try_kb: This answer comes directly from the local knowledge base (no model)
try_err: Could not reach the service. Is Simorgh running?
ex2_q: «کز نیستان تا مرا ببریده‌اند» از کیست؟
ex3_label: A work that does not exist (Persian question)
ex3_q: درباره کتاب «کلیات ارزان» از مولانا چه می‌دانی؟
s5_p1: A label such as [Quran | …] or [Poem | …] means the text came straight from the local database, not from the model's memory.
s5_p2: The badge “generated by a model” means the model wrote the text; check any quotation against a reliable source.
s5_p3: If no model is available, Simorgh says so plainly and answers only from its knowledge base.
s6_p1: Small local models can be wrong, especially about lesser-known works and authors; in that case Simorgh adds a warning under the answer.
s6_p2: Chat memory is only the last few messages of the current session and is switched off with SIMORGH_CHAT_MEMORY=off.
s6_p3: Question analysis is Persian-first; the quality of English answers depends on your local model.
s7_p: Copy locales/en.json, name it locales/language-code.json and translate only the values; the keys must not change. Then send a pull request.
foot: This page works offline and sends no personal data anywhere.
